Subject: Pilot credits and burn-rate check-in

Hi Alice —

Great to meet earlier! Quick recap from our discovery call and next steps so we’re aligned: 

- Current goal: validate summarization and triage workflows across ~3k weekly customer conversations; integrate Redwood for high-quality summarization and retrieval.
- Pilot scope: 4 endpoints (chat summarization, thread classification, semantic search embeddings, reranking).
- Ask from your side: confirm expected token volumes (inbound + generated) and target budget for pilot / target $/1M tokens so we can model unit economics.

From the call you mentioned a rough starting burn of ~20M tokens/month and a target budget of $8k–$12k/month during pilot. Can you confirm that and share any recent usage export? That will help me propose a pricing/credits plan.

Next steps:
1) Alice shares last 7–14 day token export (ACME pilot usage) — please attach CSV.
2) I’ll send a short pricing note + recommended credits extension (if needed) and outline a 2-week extension plan we can approve internally.
3) Lauren will follow up on integration checklist and any SSO requirements.

I’ve attached a quick pilot plan template (pilot_plan.xlsx) to help map success criteria.

Thanks — talk soon,
Marissa

Thanks Marissa — great summary. Quick answers: 

- Confirmed: current pilot estimate is ~18–22M tokens/month (mix of short chats + generated summaries). Peak days hit ~1.2M tokens.
- Target budget: we were hoping to stay under $10k/month for the pilot (including any credits).
- Target $/1M tokens: we’d like to land around $800–$1,000 / 1M if possible given our budget constraints.

I attached the last 14 days of usage (acme_pilot_usage_20260810.csv) — it includes day-by-day token counts + sample payloads.

Question: can you outline how Redwood’s unit economics map to those numbers (e.g., if we run 20M tokens/month, what’s the estimated monthly bill before/after credits at your proposed rate)? Also, are you able to extend the trial credits by two weeks? That would help us finish the integration and show ROI.

Best,
Alice

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credits and burn-rate check-in

Thanks Alice — useful data, appreciated. Quick pricing sketch and recommendation: 

- Assumptions: 20M tokens/month baseline (we’ll model both 18M and 22M in the doc).
- Redwood suggested retail: $1,200 / 1M tokens for the model family we discussed (higher-quality open model with lower latency ops).
- For pilots, we commonly offer a discounted trial rate or credits to surface ROI. At $1,200 / 1M, 20M tokens monthly = $24,000 / month.
- To meet your $10k/month target, we can do a combination of:
  - apply $12k in trial credits across the pilot period (reduces first month to $12k out-of-pocket), and
  - offer a temporary pilot discount to $900 / 1M for any overage during the trial window.

This gets you to an effective first-month cost near your target while giving us runway to demonstrate value. I’ve attached a short calc in the pilot_plan.xlsx sheet (updated).

Requesting internal approval to extend $12k in free credits for a two-week extension so Acme can finish integration. Michael — can you confirm if we can approve $12k credits for RD-4521? If not, what’s the approved maximum?

Lauren — can you confirm SSO/roles checklist ETA so we can schedule the integration call?

If approved I’ll send an official note and update the HubSpot deal with credit line and MRA. Proposed follow-up: 30-min technical check on Tuesday 8/17.

Thanks,
Marissa

--
